units.name: 國一　字彙
v: My father is a ____. He works in a hospital.
It's hot today. Let's go to the ____ and swim.
Amy is my father's sister. She is my ____.
I'm ____. May I have some water?
We have English class on ____, the day after Monday.
The store opens at nine in the ____ and closes at ten at night.
Put the milk in the ____. It keeps food cold.
Ben is very ____. He is always kind to others.
My sister likes ____ class. She draws pictures every day.
Please ____ the lights when you leave the room.
turn off (phr.) 關掉（電燈、電器）
This T-shirt is too ____. I need a smaller one.
Kevin ____ his teeth after every meal.
There are four ____ in a year: spring, summer, fall, and winter.
My grandma lives in the ____. There are many trees and farms there.
The movie is very ____. Everyone is laughing.
Don't ____ the street when the light is red.
I take the ____ to school. It stops right in front of my house.
Tom is very ____. He is 185 centimeters.
Mom is cooking dinner in the ____.
Our teacher is very ____. We must hand in our homework on time.
It's a ____ day. The sun is shining.
The bookstore is ____ the bank and the post office.
Look at the ____ on the wall. It's 3:15 now.
We ____ our hands before we eat.

units.name: 國一　文法
g: Mary and her brother ____ in the same school.
Mary and her brother 是複數主詞，be 動詞用 are。
主詞 your parents 是複數，問句用 Are。
This is my new bike. ____ color is blue.
「它的」用所有格 Its；It's 是 It is。
These books are ____. Please give them back to me.
mine = my books（所有格代名詞）。
Jenny ____ breakfast at seven every morning.
主詞第三人稱單數＋現在簡單式，動詞加 s。
第三人稱單數的否定：doesn't + 原形動詞。
____ Tom play basketball after school? Yes, he does.
回答用 does，問句就用 Does。
Be quiet! 表示此刻正在發生，用現在進行式。
What ____ you doing now? I'm reading a comic book.
現在進行式問句：What are you doing?
否定祈使句：Don't + 原形動詞。
There ____ some milk in the bottle.
milk 是不可數名詞，用 There is。
There ____ thirty students in our class.
否定句用 any；homework 不可數。
請別人吃東西的問句用 some。
____ is that girl? She is my cousin, Lisa.
____ do you go to school? By MRT.
____ do you like summer? Because I can swim in the sea.
Listen! 表示正在發生，用現在進行式。
Peter and I 是複數，用 are。
How many ____ do you have? I have three.
How ____ is this cake? It's 80 dollars.
主詞 She，do 要變成 does。
Please give ____ a hand. The box is heavy.
The children ____ in the park now.
now 表示正在做；children 是複數，用 are + V-ing。

units.name: 國二　字彙
v: The bread smells ____. Can I have a piece?
Sam was ____ because he lost his wallet.
My parents gave me a bike as a birthday ____.
The museum is ____ on Mondays, so we can't go in.
Wear a ____ when you ride a scooter. It keeps your head safe.
Mr. Lin is a ____. He writes stories for children.
Don't be ____ to ask questions in class.
The ____ says it will rain hard tomorrow.
I need to ____ money for a new phone.
The math test was so ____ that nobody finished it.
Our class ____ the singing contest and got first prize.
Please ____ the trash into the right bin.
We went ____ in the mountains last weekend.
The little boy was ____ of the big dog.
Mom ____ me to clean my room before dinner.
ask sb. to V 要求某人做…
Turn right at the ____, and you will see the park.
The concert was so ____. I want to go again!
I forgot my umbrella, so I got ____ in the rain.
The ____ of the story is a brave little girl.
Please speak ____. The baby is sleeping.
This jacket is on ____. It's only 300 dollars.
We need to ____ the classroom before the teacher comes.
The train was ____, so we waited for thirty minutes.
Can I ____ your eraser? I'll give it back later.
He is ____ of his son because he won the race.

units.name: 國二　文法
g: 過去式的一般動詞問句用 did。
She didn't ____ to the party last night.
Tom ____ TV when his mom came home.
過去某個時間正在做：was/were + V-ing。
It ____ rain tomorrow. Take an umbrella.
tomorrow 用未來式 will + 原形動詞。
We are going ____ a picnic this Saturday.
be going to + 原形動詞。
My room is ____ than my sister's.
This is the ____ movie I have ever seen.
Jack runs as ____ as his brother.
I want ____ a doctor in the future.
I stayed home ____ I was sick.
It was raining, ____ we didn't go out.
____ you study hard, you will pass the test.
When I got home, my mom ____ dinner.
過去某個時間正在做，用過去進行式。
He ____ late for school. He is a good student.
頻率副詞放在 be 動詞後面。
There ____ a lot of people in the park yesterday.
yesterday 用過去式；people 是複數，用 were。
I have a lot of homework ____ tonight.
不定詞修飾名詞：homework to do。
Which is ____, the sun or the moon?
She ____ to music when the phone rang.
電話響時她正在聽音樂，用過去進行式。
Remember ____ the door when you leave.
How long did it ____ you to finish the report?
It takes + 人 + 時間 + to V。
I spent two hours ____ the book.
Both Amy and I ____ good at math.
Both A and B 當主詞是複數。
Which season do you like ____, spring or fall?
兩者之間選一個用 better。
The children were ____ when they saw the clown.
Mike is ____ boy in his class.
三者以上比較用 the + 最高級。

units.name: 國三　字彙
v: The earthquake ____ many buildings in the city.
It's ____ to use your phone while you are driving.
She practiced every day, and her hard work finally ____ off.
The ____ of this town has grown to 50,000.
He is an ____ person. He always tells the truth.
We should ____ energy by turning off lights we don't use.
The doctor gave me some ____ for my cough.
The movie is based on a ____ event that happened in 1999.
Please ____ this form and give it back to me.
I'm ____ about the test tomorrow. I didn't study enough.
The company decided to ____ more workers because business is good.
The new MRT line makes it more ____ to travel around the city.
He ____ to call me back, but he never did.
The ____ between the two countries lasted for ten years.
Tina has a good ____ of humor. Everyone likes her jokes.
Smartphones have ____ the way people communicate.
Please keep ____. The movie is starting.
Plastic bags take hundreds of years to ____.
The team captain has the ____ to make final decisions.
My grandfather is 90, but he still has a good ____.
The flight was ____ because of the heavy snow.
I can't ____ which dress to buy. They are both pretty.
The ____ of the novel is about a boy who travels through time.
Volunteers ____ food to people in need.

units.name: 國三　文法
g: since + 時間點，用現在完成式。
Have you ever been...? 用現在完成式問經驗。
She has ____ finished her homework. She's watching TV now.
疑問句「已經…了嗎」用 yet。
We have been friends ____ ten years.
被動語態過去式：was + 過去分詞。
被動語態：be + 過去分詞。
The new library will ____ next year.
未來式被動：will be + 過去分詞。
The girl ____ is standing by the door is my sister.
先行詞是人，關係代名詞用 who。
This is the book ____ I bought yesterday.
先行詞是物，用 that 或 which。
I have a friend ____ father is a pilot.
表示「…的」的所有關係用 whose。
間接問句用直述句語序。
Can you tell me what time ____?
間接問句：what time it is。
附加問句：肯定句配否定的附加問句。
否定句配肯定的附加問句。
The box is so heavy ____ I can't carry it.
She is too young ____ to school.
My grandpa ____ smoke, but he quit ten years ago.
used to + V：過去常常（現在不再）。
The movie was ____. I fell asleep.
事物讓人覺得…用 -ing 形容詞。
I don't know ____ to do next.
疑問詞 + to V：what to do。
It ____ me two hours to finish the puzzle.
It took + 人 + 時間 + to V。
Not only Amy but also her parents ____ coming.
not only A but also B，動詞跟 B 一致。
The man ____ a red hat is my uncle.
現在分詞片語修飾名詞：the man wearing a red hat。
He has lived here ____ he was a child.
現在完成式被動：has been + 過去分詞。
This bridge ____ more than 100 years ago.
過去的被動語態：was + 過去分詞。

units.name: 會考練習　對話・閱讀・綜合

src.c: 會考練習　對話・閱讀・綜合

c: A: Could you pass me the salt?　B: ____
Here you are. 表示把東西遞給對方。
A: I'm going to take the English test tomorrow.　B: ____
祝對方考試順利說 Good luck!
A: Would you mind closing the window?　B: ____
Would you mind...? 回答 Not at all. 表示不介意、願意做。
A: What's wrong? You look pale.　B: ____
What's wrong? 問對方怎麼了。
A: How often do you go to the gym?　B: ____
A: How long have you studied English?　B: ____
How long have you...? 用 for + 一段時間回答。
A: Why don't we eat out tonight?　B: ____
Why don't we...? 是提議，同意說 That's a good idea.
A: Excuse me, is this seat taken?　B: ____
A: I failed the math test again.　B: ____
Cheer up! You'll do better next time.
A: Hello. May I speak to Mr. Chen?　B: ____
電話中請對方稍等：Hold on, please.
Notice: The school library will be closed from July 1 to July 10 for repairs.　Q: When can students borrow books again?
Lisa got up late. She ran to the bus stop, but the bus had already left, so she took a taxi and got to school on time.　Q: How did Lisa go to school?
文中說 she took a taxi。
Tom: I'll be fifteen next Friday. My mom will make a big cake for me.　Q: What will happen next Friday?
Tom 下週五滿 15 歲，是他的生日。
Sale! Buy one T-shirt for 300 dollars, and get the second one at half price.　Q: How much do two T-shirts cost?
Ken loves playing basketball, but he doesn't like watching it on TV. He thinks it's boring.　Q: Which is true?
Ken likes watching basketball on TV.
Ken thinks playing basketball is boring.
他喜歡打籃球，覺得看轉播很無聊。
The zoo opens at 9:00 a.m. and closes at 5:00 p.m. The last ticket is sold at 4:00 p.m.　Q: Amy arrived at 4:30 p.m. What happened?
Grandma: Remember to wear your coat. It's going to be cold this afternoon.　Q: What does Grandma want?
She wants the child to stay warm.
提醒穿外套，是希望孩子保暖。
Class 801 collected 120 bottles, and Class 802 collected 90. Class 803 collected 30 more than Class 802.　Q: How many bottles did Class 803 collect?
A: Is it far from here to the train station?　B: ____
It's about ten minutes on foot.
A: Thank you for inviting me to dinner.　B: ____
別人道謝時說 My pleasure.
Many people ____ their old clothes to charity every year.
The concert was ____ because of the typhoon. It will be held next week instead.
I can't find my key. I must have ____ it at school.
must have + 過去分詞：（過去）一定是…
Jenny is the only student ____ got a perfect score.
Sarah: I've read this novel three times, and I still love it!　Q: How does Sarah feel about the novel?
Pool rules: 1. Take a shower first. 2. No running. 3. Children under 10 must swim with an adult.　Q: Which is NOT allowed?
規則第 2 條：不准奔跑。
A: Which do you prefer, tea or coffee?　B: ____
二選一的問題，直接說出選擇。
The more you practice, the ____ you will become.
the + 比較級…, the + 比較級…：越…就越…
Mark's train leaves at 7:40. It takes him 20 minutes to walk to the station.　Q: What time should Mark leave home at the latest?
